visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a woman in a yellow long-sleeved shirt and a tan baseball cap eating from a white paper box on a sunny street. Behind her is a red temple-style gate and a traditional stone lion statue. (2) The scene cuts to her standing in front of a large arched entrance labeled 'Puzi First Retail Market' in Chinese, where she waves energetically to the camera. (3) She visits the first food stall, 'Zhen Hao Wei,' indicated by a yellow and red standing sign. The camera shows a queue of customers and a close-up of a large metal pot filled with braised duck pieces and sauce. (4) Back on the street, she holds a spoonful of rice and duck meat toward the camera before eating it with a satisfied expression. (5) The second location is 'Ah Pang Cold Drinks,' marked by a blue and green sign. The shot focuses on blocks of translucent jelly resting on ice behind a glass display. (6) She is seen holding a piece of yellow jelly wrapped in plastic, pointing out its texture. (7) At the third shop, 'Yong Feng Spring Rolls,' a large crowd is shown queuing. A close-up reveals a cook's hands in blue gloves assembling a spring roll with noodles, meat, and vegetables. (8) The woman eats a large, thick spring roll, her eyes widening as she reacts to the flavor. (9) At the final stop, 'Mochi Dong,' a close-up shows hands expertly shaping round mochi balls on a wooden tray. (10) The video ends with a graphic outro featuring her photo inside a floral wreath and social media buttons.
